crash_summary: MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value in X86_Intel_printInst at /src/capstonenext/arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c:745:24, called from cs_disasm (cs.c:930) and LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput (fuzz_disasm.c:257). Uninitialized value stored in printMemReference (X86IntelInstPrinter.c:1012), originating from the 'mci' stack allocation in cs_disasm (cs.c:845). Matches OSS-Fuzz issue 42473836: 'Use-of-uninitialized-value found by fuzz target fuzz_disasmnext [msan]' — same fuzz target, same detector class (msan/CWE-457), same crashing function X86_Intel_printInst. Identical stack trace and DEDUP tokens reproduced both via the stock vulnerable image (00_prepare default run) and via the Stage 01 workspace container after a fresh `/bin/arvo compile` of capstonenext at commit 6bdc66c066dc0a2b2fd2c9cbebd7b2dbee4f61ad.
